'''Gray Squadron 1'''<ref name="CCG-Gray1" /> was a [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter]]<ref name="S3" /> in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fighter was part of [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gray Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], piloted by [[Gray Leader/Legends|Gray Leader]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]]<ref name="CCG-Gray1" /> with [[Kin Kian (Human)|Kin Kian]] serving as his [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="CCG-Kian">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Kin Kian}}</ref>

During the Battle of Endor, Gray Squadron 1 was ordered to disable [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] sitting between [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Calrissian's]] strike force and the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Salm flew the fighter into the interior of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] alongside other Alliance fighters in an attempt to destroy the Death Star.<ref name="CCG-Gray1" />
